text: Overhead view of a light grey lab bench with white aluminium extrusion framing. Running diagonally across the left is a rail/plate holding a white strip with recessed circular wells; the wells appear empty, and metal screws/clamps sit between them. In the centre a grey vertical post or bracket rises from the bench, with a white card bearing a black-and-white square fiducial marker (labelled with small digits) mounted on its side. On top of this post stands a small squeeze bottle, upright, capped with a pointed blue-green nozzle and containing dark teal liquid. To the right lies a black flat clip or tag connected to a thin cable. Background: white pedestal block, dark upright posts, white instrument housings at right.
